en: Okay... Let's go home, Dad!
So you're good now, Haruka?
Hey, wait up! I haven't had a chance to thank you properly. I know it's not much, but here, take this.
You got <Color:8>Beads of Good Fortune<Color:Default>.
Thanks, mister. I hope you can go see your Haruka-chan sometime. I bet she misses you, too.
Like you said, isn't it a dad's job to bring their kids back home when they run away?
...You're right.
(Not that it was Haruka who ran away...)
Is this the place? Where's my daughter?
She should be here...
I don't see her anywhere! What's the meaning of this!?
Over here, you old farts!
Haruka? What's going on here?
It's those guys that were tormenting that puppy. Looks like they're back with reinforcements.
You may think you're tough, but we have strength in numbers now. You don't stand a chance!
You'll be dead as a doornail by the time we're finished with you!
You stay back. I can take these guys.
I can't let you do this alone. They've taken my daughter hostage. What kind of father could just stand here and watch!?
All right. Then let's take them on together. Time to give these brats a lesson in humility!
Dude. We are so, so sorry! Please don't hurt us anymore!
You got a pack of <Color:8>1-2-3 Gum<Color:Default>.
Um... Thanks, mister!

Don't mention it. They didn't hurt you, did they? If you'd
like, I can take you home.
Actually, I ran away... I had a fight with my dad.
A kind girl like you really ran away from home?
Yeah... My dad's probably still angry with me. So I don't want to go back right now.
What's your name?
...It's Haruka. Haruka Shinohara.
Haruka!? Interesting... Even your name is the same.
The same as who?
So you and this Haruka-chan live apart now?
Yeah... I'm not sure I'll ever see her again.
Why not? Can't you just go and visit?
It's a bit more complicated than that. As much as I want to be in her life... I know I'm only being selfish.
Besides, I think I've done all I can for her as a father. This is probably for the best.
How about you? Why'd you run away?
Here's the thing. I'm not actually related to my dad, either.
I guess that's another thing I've got in common with your Haruka-chan. Strange, isn't it?

My real dad died a long time ago. And normally, my stepdad's
really nice... but he gets super angry these days. Something
about work not going well. I don't know the details.

Anyway, he blew up at me for some reason, and I told him to
his face, "My <Italic>real</Italic> dad would never yell at me!" Then I left
the house...

When I mentioned having a real dad, my stepdad got this
really sad look on his face... He just kept staring at me,
like he'd been hit in the head or something.
That's when I knew I'd hurt his feelings real bad. I guess that's why he didn't come running after me.
*sniffle* I bet Mom and Dad are glad I'm not around to cause trouble anymore...
So... So now... I've got nowhere to go home! *sob*
Where do you live, Haruka? I'll go get your dad to come pick you up.
But I don't think he... *sigh*
Your dad was probably just caught off guard. There's no way he'd be happy you're gone. I'm sure of it.
It's also a dad's job to bring his kids home when they run away. You just need to wait for him.
Where's your dad right now?
Probably at Café Portugal, working with Mom. We actually live in that building.
Café Portugal? Okay. I'll be back with your dad soon. Just hang tight for a bit.
Okay, me next! I'll hit it for sure this time! Just you watch!
Stop it! Don't you bully Chiro anymore!
Who's this kid? Is that her dog?
Who cares? Hey, kid! You better scoot, or we'll throw rocks at you next!

Heh, yeah! Show no mercy! That's how we dropouts do it!
Screw the rules! Annihilate everything!
Oh no!

Huh? Who's this old prick? You lost on your way to the
bingo game?
Funny... I feel like this isn't the first time seeing this.
And now he's babbling on like a senile old fool. He's losing it!
Hey, mister? You're not... one of them, are you?
Not even close. Just stand back and you'll see.
You there. Does it make you feel strong to pick on the weak and defenseless? It's a shame I have to say this, but I guess every town has its fair share of losers.
Shut your face! You shoulda never messed with us in the first place! Boys, cripple this sonuvabitch!
Yowl!

en: (Was that a dog?)

Argh! That was amazing, yo! You wiped the dance floor with
me!
*pant* *pant* Well, I managed to pull it off, but...

Dancing is seriously hard work; I'd have to give up smoking
if I wanted to do this for a living... I've definitely
gained some newfound respect for Haruka-chan.

But your footwork⑬it's out of this world! I was right about you,
yo.

Aight, like I promised, you can now officially call yourself
"the man who beat Hide."
Er, no thanks. That's one title I won't be using.
Unggh! My back!
Yo, you all right?

Oww... I think so. That'll teach me not to try anything like
that again.

I guess you was tellin' the truth when you said you weren't
a dancer. Sorry I made you do that.
Urk! Owww...
Here, take this. Maybe it'll help with your back.

You ain't exactly young anymore, yo. Take care of yourself,
aight!?

This dude's too frickin' tough. Guy really knows how to
fight!
Please, man, forgive us!

Yeah, you saved us. For some reason Osaka dialect makes guys
like that way scarier...

Yo! I saw you lay the smackdown on those guys. You're really
somethin', you know that?
Huh? Who might you be?

I'm Hide, yo! I'm a dancer! What was that funky footwork
you were flippin' out there?
I don't know how I'm supposed to answer that.

Not many guys can hop around like you. You're like some
kinda spring-heeled demon! That told me everything I needed
to know!
Oh, yeah? And what's that?

Your true identity, what else!? You're a dancer, ain't you?
And a damn good one, too.
Haha, hardly. I'm nothing like that.

Don't play dumb, yo! You don't need footwork like that just
to kick fools around in the street! No way!
(Why do I attract these weirdos?)

From the looks of you, you ain't from around here. Don't
tell me you came all the way to Sotenbori without plannin'
to take me on, yo!
Well, I don't even know who you are, so...

I told you, man, I'm Hide! The dancer! You got memory
problems or somethin'?
No, I remember that, but that's not the point.

Okay, word. Yeah, I'm still a rising star, but it won't be
long before I'm a household name.

You can't call yourself a dancer then breeze right by me
like it's nothin', yo!
...Sure, pal, whatever you say. Look, I have to get going.

Yo, you're runnin' away!? Forget that! I challenge you to a
duel!
...A duel?

A dance battle! If you win, you'll be known far and wide as
"the man who beat Hide"!
I think I can live without that title.

But if you run, you'll be forever branded "the chicken who
ran from Hide." You wanna live with that, yo?
I keep telling you, I'm not a dancer.
You sayin' you're cool with being a chicken!?

Ya gave us the eye, didn't ya? Get down on all fours and beg
for forgiveness!

Wait, we did no such thing. We weren't looking at you
whatsoever...

The fuck is that? Tokyo talk? Ugh, your accent makes me
wanna yack!
But, we didn't, uh... We ain't given ya no dirty look.
Ya little shit! You dissin' the Osaka dialect!?
No, we...!
Yo, mind if I cut in?

The fuck do you want? Keep your nose outta where it don't
belong!

Please help us! These guys started harassing us for no
reason. They're totally ruining our field trip!
Whaddya mean, harassin'? Shut your mouth, bitch!

Easy there, tiger. They're just a couple of high school
kids. How about letting them go, eh?
Shaddup! I told ya to keep outta this!

Okay, Haruka-chan. Here's where we're filming the report.
It's a Japanese cuisine restaurant named Komian.

I was thinking I would introduce each dish, and then you
could taste it and give your opinion. How does that sound?

Right. Tatsuya can't try the food himself right now, what
with his stomachache and all, so his role would be to
explain and give commentary.

All you have to do is follow my lead and make a few remarks
about each dish.
All right. I'll do my best!
Great! Are you ready? It's time to get started!
Oh, Haruka-chan! It's you!
Oh, hello, Tatsuya-san.

What perfect timing! I'm really sorry, but could I ask
you a favor?
A favor? Sure. What is it?

Well, we're just about to start the filming of a show
segment on location. This is the director, Ichimura-san.
Nice to meet you. I'm Ichimura.

Hello. It's very nice to meet you. I'm Haruka Sawamura, from
Dyna Chair.

Anyway, I'm supposed to be doing a gourmet report right now,
but, unfortunately, I have a really bad stomachache. Ow!

I'm afraid I couldn't possibly eat anything at the moment.
So, I hate to ask you this, but do you think you could help
me do the report?

Hey, great idea, Tatsuya! We are kind of in an emergency,
after all.
But I've never done a gourmet report before...

That's all right. Nobody expects you to be a food expert.
All you have to do is try the dishes and give your honest
opinion.
Ouch! Here comes another wave! Ngh!
Are you all right?

Oh, please, Haruka-san! You'd really be helping Tatsuya out!
And you'd get paid, too, of course.

What do you say, Haruka? Will you help me do the report? Ow!
Ow! Ow!

All right. If you think I can be of any help to you at all,
I'm willing to give it a try.
You will? Oh, thank goodness! You're a lifesaver, Haruka!

We really appreciate this! Tell you what, I'll call Dyna
Chair and make the arrangements.

Now, let's get over to the restaurant! Everybody's waiting
for us!
I'm really sorry, but I don't think I'd be any help.

No!? Are you sure? Now what are we going to do,
Ichimura-san?
Hmm. We're pretty much up the creek...

Oh, Haruka-chan! Have you changed your mind about helping
with the report? I think my stomachache is getting worse!

Yes, if you could do this, Haruka-chan, you'd really be
helping Tatsuya-san out! And you'd get paid, too, of course.

Well, here we are at Komian, a Japanese restaurant in
Sotenbori.
And today, we have a special guest.
Wildly popular singer, Haruka Sawamura-chan!
Hello, everyone! I'm Haruka Sawamura!

You live and work here in Osaka, don't you, Haruka? Have you
ever been to Komian before?

No, this is my very first time. I can't wait to see what
kind of dishes they'll serve!

Well, you're in for a real treat. I had to eat my way across
all of Sotenbori before finding this jewel.

Today, you'll get to enjoy the refinement and elegance of
traditional Japanese cuisine!
I'm really looking forward to it!

No. I'm not really all that crazy about Japanese cuisine, so
I never come to places like this.

No? I see. Well, you certainly are an honest girl, aren't
you?
Oh! Uh, I'm sorry!

That's all right. It actually makes introducing this
restaurant to you all the more exciting! Maybe this will be
the day you change your mind!

I ate my way across all of Sotenbori, and this place was one
of the very best. Now then, are ready to order?
Yes, I think so!
Yes, I'm actually a regular here. I just love this place!

A regular!? Really? I was looking forward to introducing it
to you.

Oh! Uh, I'm sorry! But I can certainly try to see it
through fresh eyes again, as if I were coming here for the very first time.

All right. Well, at least I can introduce the place to the
folks at home!
Yeah, sorry about that...

The first dish is Komian's sashimi platter, raw slices of
fish so fresh, they were actually still swimming in the tank
just moments ago!

This dish has been prepared especially for you, so I really
hope you enjoy it.
I'm sure I will!
Well, Haruka-chan?

(Mmm, it's so good! The fish is so fresh! But what do I say
about it?)
Mmm, it's delicious!

Isn't it? But what do you think? In what way is it so
delicious?
What way? Well, uh, it's extremely delicious...

Uh, okay. Yes, I'm sure it is. They serve some of the best
sashimi I've ever tasted here.

(Oh, all right. I get it. Just saying "it's delicious"
doesn't give Tatsuya-san much to respond to.)
This sashimi's practically melting in my mouth!

Wonderful, isn't it? You only get to experience such a
sensation with the very freshest sashimi.
Oh, it's delicious!

I knew you would like it! I was looking forward to seeing
that delightful smile of yours.

Aw! Well, thank you. It really is so very soft and yummy. I
can see why you recommended it!
